domain-information: A Store Clerk scans items at checkout to process the customer’s payment for the purchase.
A Store Clerk registers the bill for the purchase.
A Store Clerk deletes or alters an item in a purchase.
A Store Clerk reports low stock on certain items so they can be reordered.
A Store Manager supervises inventory logs for items to monitor stock levels and sales trends.
A Store Manager accesses recorded purchases to analyse customer behaviour.
A Store Manager creates a sales volume report.
A Store Manager places an order with the supplier to replenish needed products.
A Supplier delivers new stock to the store to maintain inventory.
A Supplier confirms delivery quantities to ensure the store receives the correct items.
A Store Manager adjusts shelf placement in the store layout based on product popularity to improve sales.

domain objects.name: Store Clerk
domain objects.description: Employee who processes purchases and manages frontline operations.

domain objects.name: Customer
domain objects.description: Person buying items at the store.

domain objects.name: Item Scan
domain objects.description: Recorded scan of an item during checkout.

domain objects.name: Payment
domain objects.description: Transfer of money from the customer for the purchase.

domain objects.name: Purchase
domain objects.description: Transaction containing selected store items and a bill.

domain objects.name: Store Item
domain objects.description: Product available for sale in the store.

domain objects.name: Price
domain objects.description: Cost assigned to a store item.

domain objects.name: Bill
domain objects.description: Charge summary for a completed purchase.

domain objects.name: Low Stock Report
domain objects.description: Notice indicating that a store item is running low.

domain objects.name: Store Manager
domain objects.description: Person overseeing store operations, inventory and reporting.

domain objects.name: Inventory Log
domain objects.description: Record of store item quantities and movement.

domain objects.name: Replenishment Order
domain objects.description: Order issued to supplier for more store items.

domain objects.name: Supplier
domain objects.description: External provider that supplies items to the store.

domain objects.name: Stock Delivery
domain objects.description: Arrival of ordered items from the supplier.

domain objects.name: Sales Volume Report
domain objects.description: Summary report of item sales over a given period.

associations.description: Store Clerk creates and updates the Purchase.
Store Clerk performs an Item Scan.
Item Scan references the scanned Store Item.
Store Clerk creates the Low Stock Report.
Low Stock Report is delivered to the Store Manager.
Store Manager consults the Inventory Log.
Store Manager creates the Replenishment Order.
Replenishment Order is submitted to the Supplier.
Stock Delivery is confirmed by the Store Manager.
Store Manager generates the Sales Volume Report.
